dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Alright, let me give your potion a try... Yep, the effect looks good. The quality of your potion is quite high as well. Your talent in this discipline is truly remarkable.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, we passed? Can we teach alchemy now?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: What an amazing achievement, cuties. Congratulations.

choices.text: I guess we've learned a thing or two about potion-making.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Now is not the time to be humble.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: You mastered potion-making in such a short amount of time. That's an impressive achievement no matter how you look at it.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Exactly! I was also really surprised at how quickly you picked it up. I thought it would have taken way more time...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Anyway, thank you so much for your help. Your participation has allowed me to collect some very valuable data. With everything we've learned, we should be able to offer the official exams soon.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: This is sure to be a critical moment in the development of the alchemical potions industry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon feels like she just took part in something super important!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Of course! You two are practically pioneers! What you've been able to contribute to the field of alchemy is as impressive as a biologist discovering a new species!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Anyway... I should probably head back and go over the data I've collected.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, thanks again for your participation. If you have some free time, please stop by the lab!

choices.text: But we're still by no means experts when it comes to everything else.
